name: NemoClaw ManyForge Direct Tools
description: Replaces OpenClaw's tool-search compaction surface (tool_search_code / tool_search / tool_describe / tool_call) with the full ManyForge MCP catalog when the active provider is NemoClaw-managed local inference. Mirrors the kimi-inference-compat pattern (PR #4120). The catalog is baked in at sandbox-image build time via the companion build script in NemoClaw-Thor.
